prompt_text: Which title company in St. Louis MO is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” title company—the right choice depends on your lender, location, fees, and how responsive the closing team is. **Investors Title Company** looks like a strong all-around option from the information available: it has served Missouri since 1972, offers residential closings across the St. Louis area, and has in-house attorneys and escrow staff.

Other options worth comparing:

- **Freedom Title** — multiple St. Louis-area locations and in-house legal and closing teams.
- **Home Title** — specializes in residential purchases and refinances, and serves Missouri and Illinois.
- **Security Title** — offers residential closings at several area offices.

Before choosing, ask your lender whether it has any requirements, then compare the **written title/closing fee estimate**, office or mobile-closing convenience, and who your specific closer will be. The company’s name matters less than clear communication and a reliable person handling your file.
